description: Ministry of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms - The Recognition and Enforcement of International Settlement Agreements Resulting from Mediation Act. No 5 of 2024
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the implementation of a specific legal act (The Recognition and Enforcement of International Settlement Agreements Resulting from Mediation Act, No. 5 of 2024) and certifies the entry into force of an international convention (United Nations Convention on International Settlement Agreements Resulting from Mediation) in Sri Lanka. While it mentions a minister's name and title, the core content is about legal/regulatory matters - specifically the operationalization of legislation and international treaty implementation, which falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5).
